starsi.pravidloStrachu: Each player has their own thermometer at every elder: the solid part is their fear, the hatching is the opponent's rumours. The elder's state towards a player is that player's fear (uneasy, scared, terrified). Fear is raised by the brawl winner with the Thrashing and never drops; rumours are raised by the argument winner on the opponent's thermometer, from the top of their fear downwards. A notch costs {cena}. The elder gives his favour to whoever he fears less — its strength is the difference in fear, rumours don't count. After the brawl a notch is worth {hodnota} and goes to whoever holds it: rumours to both, fear only to the winner. Whoever lost the argument loses rumours from the bottom.

os.pocetPitiek: The number of Booze-ups is 1 + the smaller of the counts of activated actions of the middle card on its two wings — it changes as the players play cards next to the location.
os.finale: The last brawl, on the pinnacle (v7): whoever has fewer butts attacks (on a tie, the loser of the last brawl); the leader picks the location and the winner of the last argument sets its facing. Wings, upper hand and the number of Booze-ups work as at any location.
os.finale2: In the finale the Thrashing and the argument aren't handed out — the winner gets 1 butt per point for them instead. The elders score as after any brawl; protection money and the loser's cigarette aren't paid. Then whatever is left gets cashed in and unconfessed Cirrhosis is deducted.
os.volbaCiela: The defender (winner of the last brawl) picks the location; the winner of the previous argument sets its facing (after a tie, the defender).
os.natocenie: The facing decides which of the location's actions point towards which wing.
os.stavba: Setting up the Market: each player gets {naradie} cards from the Tools deck and {obcania} from the Citizens deck; both at once put half into the Market and half on the bottom of their deck — no passing cards across.
os.branie: Taking: in turns, the defender starts (only 1 card on the first turn) — 1 card for {jedna} cigarette, 2 cards for {dve} cigarettes. No cigarettes, no taking. Whoever stops leaves the opponent just one last turn.
os.zajatie: Capture and persuasion happen after the brawl when the points are handed out: for {zajatie} of the Thrashing you capture an elder on your red fear; for {presvedcenie} of the argument you persuade an elder who fears your opponent more than you.

os.zhromazdenieText: You take turns playing cards from your hand onto either end of the line; the attacker starts. Play limit = full shots; every card turns one to empty, and each further card in the same turn costs a cigarette as well.
os.pitkaText: You both play at once; “done” can't be undone and the NA EXes are revealed at the same time. NA EX! — a full shot on a Citizen or an Elder in the line: it cancels their active actions and doubles the inactive ones (multipliers multiply: NA EX × Strong, Independent Woman = ×4); once revealed, the opponent may answer with one card face down (attacker first, then the defender on the other wing; they flip at the same time). Smoke (a card for 1, 2, 3… cig. in each Booze-up), new shot (barter). At the end of the Booze-up {dolieva} empty shot is refilled for free, plus one per Shot action.
os.pitkaText2: Then the actions are tallied: Gamble (each action a Debt, confessed at once), Liver Damage and Shot (a Cirrhosis into the discard pile for every full threshold), Restriction, Cigarettes and Vision. The liver resets to zero after the Booze-up.
os.bitkaText: Hard damage decides it (Punch 1, Wallop 2, Haymaker 3; minus the opponent's Faith and your own Shakes). On equal hard, whoever has fewer Shakes wins, then fewer confessed Debts; otherwise it goes on the Tab — the round's butts wait for the winner of the next brawl (in the finale they're forfeited). The winner gets 1 butt for every card in the line (at least 1) and the location goes up on the pub noticeboard. The elders score right after the brawl: a notch worth {hodnota} goes to whoever holds it — rumours to both, fear only to the winner. The difference in hard is the Thrashing: the winner spends it on their fear (in the finale they get butts for it 1 : 1).
os.bitkaText2: First the argument (soft), then damage, elders, the Bailiff, and handing out the Thrashing and the argument. Then the loser gets {cigarety} cigarette and the opponent pays you protection money for your red fear. At the start of the round everyone draws {dobratie} cards. The loser is the attacker in the next round.

kriterium.zabava.otazka: Did I enjoy myself? Would I want to play again right now?
kriterium.rozhodnutia.otazka: Did my choices have real consequences? Were there several sensible options, or just one obvious one?
kriterium.rovnovaha.otazka: Did both players have the same chance? Is any strategy, card or position clearly stronger?
kriterium.nahoda.otazka: Was the game decided more by skill or by the draw? Is the balance about right?
kriterium.interakcia.otazka: Did I react to my opponent? Could I mess up their plans, or did everyone just play for themselves?
kriterium.tempo.otazka: Did the game flow, or did I wait a long time? Was the game the right length?
kriterium.zrozumitelnost.otazka: Did I understand what I'm allowed to do and why something happened?
kriterium.hlbka.otazka: Is the strategic depth worth the amount of rules?
kriterium.znovuhratelnost.otazka: Will the next game be different? Is there more than one way to win?
kriterium.tema.otazka: Does the village-pub theme fit what's going on in the game?
kriterium.napatie.otazka: Was the game tense right to the end? Could a lost position still be turned round?
kriterium.originalita.otazka: Does the game bring something you won't find elsewhere?
